tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a holiday package (flight + hotel together) to one destination country. Covers packages only, not flights or hotels alone. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_packages" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
